name: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (SOC 2)
version: 2017 Trust Services Criteria, with revised points of focus (2022)
note: Criterion identifiers are AICPA's; the titles are short paraphrases. passmcp evidences criteria for the MCP servers it tests. It cannot make an organisation SOC 2 compliant: only a CPA firm's attestation over an audit period does that.

criteria.title: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
criteria.reason: The control environment (governance, ethics, competence, accountability) is an organisational matter; no test of a server can evidence it.

criteria.title: Board independence and oversight of internal control
criteria.reason: The control environment (governance, ethics, competence, accountability) is an organisational matter; no test of a server can evidence it.

criteria.title: Structures, reporting lines, authorities and responsibilities
criteria.reason: The control environment (governance, ethics, competence, accountability) is an organisational matter; no test of a server can evidence it.

criteria.title: Commitment to attract, develop and retain competent individuals
criteria.reason: The control environment (governance, ethics, competence, accountability) is an organisational matter; no test of a server can evidence it.

criteria.title: Accountability for internal control responsibilities
criteria.reason: The control environment (governance, ethics, competence, accountability) is an organisational matter; no test of a server can evidence it.

criteria.title: Relevant, quality information to support internal control
criteria.reason: Information and communication within the organisation are organisational processes, not properties of an MCP server.

criteria.title: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
criteria.reason: Information and communication within the organisation are organisational processes, not properties of an MCP server.

criteria.title: Communication with external parties
criteria.reason: Information and communication within the organisation are organisational processes, not properties of an MCP server.

criteria.title: Objectives specified to identify and assess risks
criteria.reason: Risk assessment is performed by the organisation. passmcp's findings can be an input to it, but they do not evidence the assessment itself.

criteria.title: Identification and analysis of risks
criteria.reason: Risk assessment is performed by the organisation. passmcp's findings can be an input to it, but they do not evidence the assessment itself.

criteria.title: Potential for fraud in assessing risks
criteria.reason: Risk assessment is performed by the organisation. passmcp's findings can be an input to it, but they do not evidence the assessment itself.

criteria.title: Identification and assessment of significant changes
criteria.reason: Risk assessment is performed by the organisation. passmcp's findings can be an input to it, but they do not evidence the assessment itself.

criteria.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations of internal control
criteria.reason: Monitoring of internal control is the organisation's evaluation process; a scheduled passmcp run can support it, but no single check evidences it.

criteria.title: Evaluation and communication of internal control deficiencies
criteria.reason: Monitoring of internal control is the organisation's evaluation process; a scheduled passmcp run can support it, but no single check evidences it.

criteria.title: Control activities that mitigate risks
criteria.reason: Selecting and deploying control activities through policy is an organisational process.

criteria.title: General control activities over technology
criteria.reason: Selecting and deploying control activities through policy is an organisational process.

criteria.title: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
criteria.reason: Selecting and deploying control activities through policy is an organisational process.

criteria.title: Logical access security software, infrastructure and architectures
Registration and authorisation of new users before access
Authorisation, modification and removal of access, by role and least privilege
Restriction of physical access to facilities and assets
criteria.reason: Physical access is outside what a network or process test can observe.

criteria.title: Discontinuation of logical and physical protections over assets
criteria.reason: Disposal and discontinuation of protections over assets are not observable from a live server.

criteria.title: Security measures against threats from outside the system boundaries
Restriction of the transmission, movement and removal of information
Prevention or detection of unauthorised or malicious software
Detection of configuration changes and newly discovered vulnerabilities
Monitoring of system components for anomalies
criteria.reason: Anomaly monitoring of production systems is the operator's monitoring, not a point-in-time test.

criteria.title: Evaluation of security events
criteria.reason: Evaluating security events is an incident process run by people.

criteria.title: Response to identified security incidents
criteria.reason: Incident response is an organisational process.

criteria.title: Recovery from identified security incidents
criteria.reason: Recovery from incidents is an organisational process.

criteria.title: Authorisation, design, testing, approval and implementation of changes
Risk mitigation for business disruptions
criteria.reason: Business-disruption risk mitigation (insurance, continuity planning) is organisational.

criteria.title: Assessment and management of risks from vendors and business partners
Management of processing capacity to meet demand
Environmental protections, backup and recovery infrastructure
Testing of recovery plan procedures
criteria.reason: Testing recovery plans is an exercise run by the organisation, not by passmcp.

criteria.title: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
Disposal of confidential information
criteria.reason: Disposal of confidential information is not observable from a live server.
